title: Two-step verdict phase
statement: Let $M_V,M_I,M_P$ be finite-state Boolean-input Turing machines, let $x,u,y$ be Boolean words, and let $b$ be a Boolean. Starting the verdict-phase machine with input-head position $1$, buffer $u$, designated tape containing the one-symbol word $[b]$ with its head at position $1$, and all other designated tapes blank, after two steps it is in the verdict state recording $b$; that tape has been erased and its head is at the origin, while the buffer remains $u$. At each time $r<2$ it is not in a verdict state, and through time $2$ every work-head position has absolute value at most $1$.
